tax.text: Delgado supports eliminating California's gas tax to reduce the cost of living.
tax.quote: I support eliminating the Gas Tax, which will help make everything from food, to driving, to clothing, less expensive.

housing.text: Delgado wants to remove construction regulations so more affordable homes can be built.
housing.quote: I'll fight to eliminate unfair rules and regulations on housing construction so we can build affordable homes again.

safety.text: Delgado supports fully funding Proposition 36 and stronger enforcement against drug and theft crimes.
safety.quote: I support fully funding Proposition 36, which enacted tough new drug and theft laws, while getting offenders the help they may need.

sentencing.text: Delgado, a former assistant sheriff, criticizes soft-on-crime laws and calls for life sentences for child predators.
sentencing.quote: I'll vote to keep people safe from crime and send child predators to prison for life.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Delgado supports barring transgender girls from girls' sports and locker rooms.
gender.quote: I will work hard to ensure our girls are safe by banning biological boys in girls sports and locker rooms.
